name: maintainer-orchestrator
description: Run a single orchestrator session that wakes on a heartbeat, triages every personal repo's queue, and directs one background worker agent per repo to land safe work autonomously - escalating only decision-ready briefs to Gabe. Claude Code port of steipete's Codex maintainer loop: /loop 5m heartbeat, background agents as worker threads, SendMessage to steer, gh-driven triage, PR-only landings. Use to keep a portfolio of repos maintained hands-off, or to triage a single repo's issues/PRs/CI.
